title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).

Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.

How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Work Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Report To : JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader

Business Type : Cross-border Industrial Supply Chain / MRO Industrial Products Procurement & Sales

I. Business Introduction

JD Industrial is the core business segment of JD Group focusing on industrial supply chain technology and services. We have established a localized operation system in Brazil , focusing on providing end-to-end MRO industrial product supply chain solutions for Chinese-funded overseas enterprises and local large-scale manufacturing/energy/infrastructure enterprises.

  • Core Positioning : Serve customers in Brazil's manufacturing, energy, mining, infrastructure and other industries, providing one-stop procurement, cross-border/local fulfillment, inventory management, supply chain finance and other services for full-category MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations) industrial products.
  • Core Advantages : Relying on JD's global supply chain network, local warehousing, distribution and compliance capabilities in Brazil , and digital procurement platform, we solve the pain points of the Brazilian market such as high prices, long delivery times, scattered suppliers and complex certifications .
  • Business Scope : Covering full MRO categories including tools, labor protection, electrical, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, and spare parts , supporting the dual model of cross-border procurement + local procurement , and realizing fast delivery, compliant customs clearance and credit period settlement in Brazil.

II. Key Job Responsibilities

1. Development and Management of Local MRO Suppliers in Brazil (Core)

  • In-depth development of local MRO suppliers in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.), and establishment of a localized supplier resource pool.
  • Responsible for supplier access, evaluation, negotiation, signing, maintenance and elimination, and building a hierarchical supplier system (head/potential/long-tail).
  • Familiar with the price system, certification requirements (INMETRO), delivery time, credit period and payment habits (OA 90 days, letter of credit installments) of the Brazilian MRO market.

2. MRO Category Procurement and Cost Management

  • Responsible for the full-category MRO procurement in Brazil, undertaking customer needs, and completing the entire process of inquiry, price comparison, negotiation, order placement, fulfillment, reconciliation and settlement.
  • Formulate category procurement strategies, price systems and cost targets, optimize procurement costs, and improve price competitiveness, gross profit and inventory turnover.
  • Analyze the supply and demand, competitors, prices, delivery times and policies of the Brazilian MRO market, and formulate category planning, commodity structure and stock-up strategies.

3. Customer Demand Connection and Solution Output

  • Connect with local Chinese-funded/large-scale enterprise customers in Brazil, explore MRO procurement needs, and provide one-stop procurement solutions, cost optimization, delivery guarantee and inventory management.
  • Coordinate the entire link of cross-border procurement, local procurement, customs clearance, logistics fulfillment and local delivery to ensure timely, compliant and low-cost delivery.
  • Maintain customer relationships, improve repurchase rate, satisfaction and penetration rate, and promote large customer signing, project landing and category expansion.

4. Supply Chain Operation and Data Management

  • Responsible for the entire link operation of MRO inventory, orders, delivery, reconciliation and settlement, ensuring healthy inventory, timely delivery, compliant credit period and fund safety.
  • Track data such as sales, procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time, and output weekly/monthly/analysis reports to support business decisions.
  • Coordinate with JD Industrial's global procurement, cross-border logistics, digital systems, risk control and compliance teams to ensure coordinated, efficient and compliant business operations.

5. Compliance and Risk Management

  • Familiar with Brazilian compliance requirements such as import tariffs, INMETRO certification, commodity inspection, customs declaration, taxation, foreign exchange and labor laws, ensuring that procurement and delivery are legal and compliant.
  • Control supplier risks, price risks, delivery risks, inventory risks, fund risks and compliance risks.

III. Job Requirements

1. Core Competencies (Must-Have)

  • Local MRO Supplier Resources in Brazil : Must have local MRO industrial product supplier resources in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.).
  • MRO Procurement Professional Ability : 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement experience in Brazil/Latin America, familiar with MRO categories, products, prices, certifications, delivery times, credit periods and procurement processes.
  • In-depth Understanding of the Brazilian Market : Familiar with Brazil's industrial market, customer structure, supplier ecology, price system, certification (INMETRO), tariffs, foreign exchange and payment habits.

2. Professional Skills

  • Business Negotiation : Strong ability in price negotiation, negotiation, contract signing and supplier management.
  • Cost and Data Analysis : Price-sensitive, strong cost awareness, proficient in analyzing procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time data.
  • Language Ability : Fluent in Portuguese (native/business level), proficient in English; fluent in Chinese is preferred.
  • Office Tools : Proficient in Excel, PPT, Word and ERP/procurement systems.

3. Comprehensive Quality

  • Business Thinking : Possess the ability of category operation, cost control, profit orientation and inventory management.
  • Customer Orientation : Customer-first, strong service awareness, demand exploration, solution output and customer maintenance.
  • Pressure Resistance and Execution : Result-oriented, strong pressure resistance, strong execution, cross-departmental collaboration and rapid implementation.
  • Compliance and Integrity : Integrity and self-discipline, strong compliance awareness, risk control and high professional quality.

4. Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or above , major in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering is preferred.
  • 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement/sales experience in Brazil/Latin America; experience in local Brazilian supplier resources, Chinese-funded enterprise services and cross-border procurement is preferred.

IV. What We Offer

  • International Platform : JD Industrial's global business, with collaboration between the local Brazilian team and the China headquarters.
  • Salary and Benefits : Highly competitive salary + performance bonus + annual bonus + local Brazilian social security + commercial insurance + paid annual leave + overseas subsidies.
  • Development Space : Promotion paths such as MRO Category Manager, Regional Procurement & Sales Director, and JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader.
  • Localization Support : Local office in Brazil, local team, compliance support, supply chain support and customer resources.

title: Gerente financeiro
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to partner with the Managing Director and the market team to deliver the business plan and support operational execution. This is a managerial role focused on leadership, planning and process improvement, with also some hands-on operational tasks.

Key responsibilities

Financial and operational leadership

• Act as a trusted business partner to the Managing Director and the wider market team to deliver budget and strategy. • Own the annual budget, periodic reforecasts and the monthly forward-looking risks & opportunities view, and drive commercial action plans where required. • Break the business plan and budget into measurable building blocks and KPIs, ensure they are tracked by the FP&A team and by functional partners, and lead corrective actions when performance deviates from target. • Track return on key investments, including capex for new sales initiatives, and provide actionable analysis to improve outcomes. • Provide hands-on operational support to ensure an accurate and timely close, with an initial high level of involvement expected, followed by a substantial reduction as processes are stabilized and effectively managed by the new financial manager.

Finance team leadership

• Build and develop a high-performing finance function aligned to company strategy. • Line-manage and mentor key direct reports (for example Financial Control, treasury, Billing and Cash Collection), ensuring the right people are in the right roles. • Foster collaboration between finance and commercial teams to embed financial discipline across the market.

Process leadership

• Identify and prioritise process improvements across the business (for example debtor management) and drive execution to close the gaps. • Work with the Group finance community to implement best practices and share learnings that other markets can adopt.

Reporting and compliance

• Ensure accurate and timely monthly and annual reporting that meets Group and third-party obligations and that tracks progress against business goals and KPIs. • Plan and oversee the annual audit and tax filings, working with the Group tax and control teams to optimise outcomes. • Support wider reporting requirements such as CSRD and other regulatory or sustainability disclosures as required.

Liquidity and cash management

• Drive delivery against cash targets, ensuring profit is converted into cash. • Assign ownership and targets for each element of working capital, and drive process improvements where necessary. • Maintain a 13-week cash flow forecast and a budgeted liquidity plan. • Coordinate with Group to repatriate cash to the parent company in line with the plan.

Project leadership

• Lead ad-hoc strategic projects, including business cases for commercial opportunities and support for acquisitions or integrations as they arise. • Provide commercial and financial analysis to support decision making and monitor project outcomes.

Desired experience and skills

• Proven finance manager experience in a commercial environment, ideally with exposure to FP&A, financial control and cash management. • Strong analytical skills and experience converting financial insight into commercial action. • Experience leading finance teams and developing talent. • Comfortable working with ERP systems and driving process improvements. • Hands-on month-end close experience and a pragmatic approach to resolving operational issues. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Talent Acquisition Sr Analyst
description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

As a member of the talent acquisition team, you'll have the opportunity to work in a cross-regional team with international exposure. We spot, engage and hire the top talents to join DiDi. We drive new growth opportunities for our teams by running talent programs, where our employees can expand their horizons globally.

In this role you will be...

  • Responsible to manage the full end-to-end hiring cycle for roles across multiple teams in the organization.
  • Acting as a strategic partner to business leaders; providing world-class market information, talent intelligence and key practices.
  • Owning the overall candidate experience through the hiring process until onboarding.
  • Using data to make decisions that facilitate hiring and allows the organization to make the best hiring decision.
  • Working with other HR teams to drive efficiencies and process improvements.
  • Working in projects that impact how we shape a culture of recruiting.

We are eager to be in touch with you because you have...

  • 3-4 years of experience in recruiting (preferably in a fast-paced environment such as the internet or consulting companies).
  • Experience using ATS systems (lever, greenhouse, icims, etc).
  • Strong verbal and written communication in English and spanish.
  • Excited about driving change and helping the organization evolve.
  • Knowledgeable about talent acquisition techniques (offer negotiation, sourcing, etc).

You‘ll love working at DiDi because:

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

title: Gerente Suínocultura
description:
Garantir a produção eficiente, sustentável e de alta qualidade nas granjas (creches e engorda), por meio da gestão estratégica de pessoas, processos e recursos, assegurando o bem-estar animal, a sanidade do plantel e rentabilidade do negócio, em conformidade com as normas técnicas ambientais e de biossegurança. Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate).

  4. Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação.

  7. Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança.
  8. Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional.
  9. Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional.
  10. Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento.
  11. Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado.
  12. Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos).
  13. Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
  14. Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
  15. Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Responsibilities: 

  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.

Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Mandarin is a plus

title: Sales Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.

description:

Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.

  • Gerar planilhas de conferência, relatórios de auditoria e análises de divergências de ponto;

title: Engenheiro de rede sênior
description:
Responsável por projetar, implementar e manter a infraestrutura crítica de redes que suporta um ecossistema multi-cloud e multicanal. O desafio envolve gerenciar conectividade de alta disponibilidade para transações financeiras e de loteria, integrando redes móveis, ambientes de Contact Center (CCX/CCaaS) e roteamento complexo entre data centers físicos e provedores de nuvem, garantindo segurança e desempenho de ponta a ponta.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Roteamento e Core Switching: Gerenciar protocolos de roteamento dinâmico, com foco obrigatório em BGP para interconexão de sistemas autônomos e tráfego multi-homed.

• Conectividade Híbrida e Cloud: Implementar e gerenciar roteamento em ambientes de nuvem (AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN), garantindo comunicação fluida entre ambientes on-premises e instâncias em nuvem.

• Segurança de Perímetro e VPN: Configurar e manter túneis VPN (Site-to-Site e Client-to-Site) e infraestrutura de Firewall, com domínio em tecnologias Cisco e/ou Fortinet.

• Infraestrutura de Voz e Contact Center: Sustentar e otimizar ambientes Cisco Unified Contact Center Express (CCX) e integração com soluções CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service), garantindo Qualidade de Serviço (QoS) de voz.

• Mobilidade e Redes Sem Fio: Projetar e gerenciar redes Wi-Fi corporativas de alta densidade e configurar integração com redes móveis (4G/5G) para redundância de terminais de loteria e POS.

• Monitoramento e Performance: Utilizar ferramentas e protocolos de análise de tráfego (Wireshark, SNMP) para troubleshooting avançado e otimização de latência em transações críticas.

• Suporte a Projetos Multicanais: Garantir que a rede suporte a jornada do cliente em todos os canais (Físico, Web e App), mantendo segmentação de rede e segurança de dados em conformidade com PCI-DSS e LGPD/GDPR.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Game Technology
description:
We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team in São Paulo.

At Wildlife, senior engineers don't just execute - they own. Our Live Games Tech Team operates with end-to-end accountability across some of our most-played titles, with millions of daily active players worldwide. You'll make architectural decisions, lead technical initiatives, define how the team operates in production, and mentor the engineers around you - all without layers of approval slowing you down. The scope is large. The autonomy is real. And the scale means your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on a product that millions of people play every day.

Our stack spans Unity/C# on the client, Go on the backend, and AWS with Kubernetes for infrastructure.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex features across mobile client and backend services, making sound architectural trade-offs.
  • Own technical decisions for your area - architecture, performance, scalability, long-term maintainability - and be accountable for the outcomes.
  • Ship new versions to production and take full ownership of post-release behavior: monitoring, reading signals, and iterating fast.
  • Define and evolve the team's observability practices: SLIs, alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes.
  • Proactively identify and drive improvements across the codebase: performance, scalability, and engineering quality.
  • Mentor and coach more junior engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and pair programming.
  • Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages.
  • Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale.
  • Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers.
  • Working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development.
  • Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems.
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure.
  • Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products.

MORE ABOUT YOU

You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it.

ABOUT WILDLIFE

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, PySpark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.

Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.

If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Coordenador(a) de Incorporação
description:

O que você fará por aqui:

  • Acompanhar a obtenção de documentações e aprovações junto a órgãos federais, estaduais e municipais necessárias para o lançamento dos empreendimentos.
  • Monitorar o desenvolvimento dos projetos, assegurando a qualidade das entregas e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.

O que esperamos que você tenha:

Seria incrível se você tivesse:

  • Experiência em Incorporadoras ou construtoras;

title: Analista de Negócios Sênior
description:
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.

RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO

• Atuar como Analista de Negócios para iniciativas de Supply Chain Finance (Risco Sacado), com foco na iniciativa regulatória Duplicata Escritural.

• Ser um forte facilitador entre o time de Produtos e as áreas de Tecnologia (fornecedores locais de software terceiros e fornecedores internos globais de tecnologia).

• Coordenar múltiplas entregas ao mesmo tempo.

• Estar envolvido em análises técnicas relacionadas às soluções de software.

• Trabalhar com equipes de diferentes países e diferentes fusos horários (ex: Brasil, Estados Unidos).

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de produtos de Supply Chain Finance para antecipar mudanças e ter papel de influência nas demandas relacionadas ao Brasil.

• Ter habilidade para realizar apresentações executivas para diferentes grupos e níveis.

• Antecipar proativamente soluções e melhorias para este ambiente altamente regulado e complexo.

• Atuar como ponto de escalonamento e elo técnico para o produto de Supply Finance.

• Atuar como formador de equipe e ter boas interações e trocas com outros grupos de tecnologia.

• Ponto focal para solicitações de mudança de Supply Chain Finance (GMUD/CRQ).

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

• Fluência em português e inglês. 70% das reuniões são em inglês. Deve ser fluente.

• Experiência extensa em Supply Chain (risco sacado) ou produtos de Empréstimos.

• Graduação em Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou similar.

• Experiência com banco de dados SQL Server. Capacidade de criar e depurar consultas.

• Experiência com arquitetura de sistemas web baseados em Windows.

• Forte conhecimento em aplicações baseadas em APIs REST.

• Ter experiência prévia trabalhando com suporte na indústria de tecnologia bancária.

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos em metodologia ágil (Lean, Scrum) e no uso de ferramentas como JIRA.

• Capacidade analítica avançada para decompor problemas de negócio e definir soluções acionáveis.

• Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, modelagem de processos e tradução de necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.

• Bons conhecimentos em Excel.

• Ser capaz de recomendar soluções garantindo aderência à direção, estratégia e prioridades da unidade de negócio.

• Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.

• Interagir com uma diversidade de equipes técnicas e de negócio ao redor do mundo.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de negócios, como BPMN, UML e plataformas de gestão de requisitos.

• Conhecimento em sistemas de agendamento de processamento (Control+M, Autosys, etc).

• Ter trabalhado com o sistema FUNCAO será um diferencial.

• Conhecimento em sistemas de mensageria como MQ, Connect Direct, Kafka, XFB, Oracle AQ, etc.

• Capacidade de negociação com stakeholders/usuários e outras equipes de TI.

• Experiência em ambientes de alta pressão com múltiplas prioridades concorrentes.

Benefícios

E ai, se identificou com o que leu até agora? Então, vou te contar o que você encontrará aqui, além de um ambiente dinâmico:

• Vale refeição ou alimentação;

• Benefício Flexível (Flash);

• Assistência médica;

• Parceiros para atendimento psicológico, jurídico, financeiro e nutricional (CLUDE, C4LIFE E ASQ);

• Psicologia Viva;

• Assistência Odontológica;

• Auxílio creche;

• Auxílio para filhos com necessidades especiais;

• Auxílio fertilização;

• Extensão Licença Maternidade e Paternidade;

• Vale transporte ou Auxílio Home Office (para contrato teletrabalho);

• Gympass (Wellhub) e TotalPass;

• Horários flexíveis;

• Seguro de vida;

• Clube de parcerias;

• Parceria com Sesc;

• Just dress no code (sem código de vestimenta);

• Day off no aniversário;

• Beca (programa de incentivo a educação);

• PPR ou Bônus - conforme atingimento de metas e resultados.

Valorizamos a diversidade e entendemos que o que acrescenta é justamente ideias e pontos de vistas variados. Por isso raça, cor, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência ou idade, não serão impeditivos de você fazer parte do nosso time.

title: English Teacher
description:

Familiarity with educational technology tools and platforms. A Master's degree is considered desirable.

Please send your cover letter, résumé, and a letter of professional reference to our Human Resources department at by April 30, 2026. Please add the position you're applying for to the email subject.

About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.

Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.

In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.

Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.

School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

Posição: Professor(a) de Inglês

Principais responsabilidades: Planejar, ministrar e desenvolver aulas de Inglês para estudantes do Ensino Fundamental II, promovendo o desenvolvimento das habilidades de leitura, escrita, escuta e oralidade. Estimular o pensamento crítico, a comunicação e o desenvolvimento socioemocional dos alunos, por meio de abordagens investigativas e centradas no estudante. Trabalhar com diferentes gêneros textuais e estratégias pedagógicas, incluindo leitura guiada, produção textual, projetos e discussões estruturadas. Utilizar práticas avaliativas diagnósticas, formativas e somativas para acompanhar o progresso dos alunos, oferecer feedback contínuo e diferenciar o ensino para atender a diferentes perfis de aprendizagem, incluindo estudantes multilíngues. Colaborar ativamente com a equipe pedagógica no planejamento curricular. Manter uma comunicação efetiva com famílias, sempre alinhado ao currículo, às diretrizes institucionais e à filosofia educacional da escola.

Requisitos: Licenciatura em Letras-Inglês. Fluência em inglês. Experiência docente, preferencialmente em contextos bilíngues ou internacionais. Capacidade de atuar de forma eficaz com estudantes de diferentes contextos culturais. Habilidades de comunicação, resolução de problemas e organização. Familiaridade com ferramentas e plataformas de tecnologia educacional. Mestrado será um diferencial.

Envie seu Currículo, sua carta de apresentação e uma carta de referência profissional para o nosso departamento de Recursos Humanos no endereço até 30 de abril de 2026.

Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.

Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.

Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.

A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.

A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy

Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.

You can find additional information about our values at this link ()

The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.

Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.

Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.

What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.

Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)

In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)

We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.

Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.

In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.

As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. title: O&M Head - Latam
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

(I) Team Management and Training

1. Establish, manage, and lead an international operation and maintenance team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and personnel allocation.

2. Organize team training and technical exchange activities to improve the overall skill level and professional knowledge of the team.

(II) Safety and Quality Control

1. Ensure that operation and maintenance work complies with international safety standards and norms, and establish a sound safety management system.

2. Develop and implement quality control measures to ensure the quality and reliability of operation and maintenance work.

(III) Budget and Cost Management

1. Be responsible for the preparation and control of the operation and maintenance budget, reasonably arrange operation and maintenance expenses, and reduce operation and maintenance costs.

2. Analyze cost data and find opportunities and measures for cost optimization.

(IV) Cooperation and Communication

1. Establish good cooperative relationships with international suppliers and service providers, coordinate resources, and ensure the smooth progress of operation and maintenance work.

2. Maintain effective communication with relevant parties such as government departments and power grid companies in the project location to ensure compliant operation and a good external environment.

(V) Data Analysis and Reporting

1. Collect and analyze operation and maintenance data, evaluate wind farm performance, and provide regular operation and maintenance reports and improvement suggestions.

2. Utilize data analysis to optimize operation and maintenance strategies and decisions.

Job Requirements

(I) Educational Background:

Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Renewable Energy, or related fields.

(II) Work Experience:

1. At least five years of experience in wind power project operation and maintenance management, with priority given to candidates with international project experience.

2. Familiar with international wind power industry operation and maintenance standards and specifications.

(III) Skills Requirements:

1. Fluent in English (it will be tested). Spanish is a plus

2. Proficient in using relevant operation and maintenance management software and tools.

3. Strong ability to diagnose and resolve problems.

(IV) Competencies and Qualities:

1. Excellent team management and leadership skills, able to effectively motivate and coordinate multicultural teams.

2. Excellent communication, coordination, and negotiation skills, able to effectively cooperate with international parties.

3. Strong adaptability and resilience, able to cope with various challenges and changes in international projects.

title: Managing Director - Brazil (Crypto Payment Business)
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.

Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese; strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.

Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

O papel atua como guardião da camada de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os times de produto, viabilizando a construção de produtos de dados e analytics com qualidade, escala e consistência, por meio de regras claras de negócio, limpeza, transformação e enriquecimento dos dados.

description:

A Aperam BioEnergia, referência em inovação e sustentabilidade no setor florestal, está em busca de uma Pessoa Supervisora de Expedição para integrar uma área estratégica e em expansão, responsável por garantir eficiência, organização e excelência nas operações e no uso dos recursos internos.

A Aperam BioEnergia se destaca pela produção de carvão vegetal de alta eficiência para a fabricação do Aço Verde Aperam, além de tecnologias, mudas e sementes florestais. Com certificações FSC® e ISO 14001 e 45001, atuamos com manejo florestal baseado nas melhores práticas, unindo responsabilidade ambiental, social e econômica.

Ao utilizarmos 100% de carvão vegetal em nossos altos-fornos, reduzimos significativamente nossa pegada de carbono e reforçamos nosso compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável. Acreditamos no poder das pessoas para transformar desafios em resultados consistentes — e é com esse espírito que buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer e construir junto com a gente.

Se você gosta de organização, estruturação de processos, uso estratégico de dados e atuação direta com equipes operacionais, essa vaga é para você!

Por que escolher a Aperam?

Somos um lugar incrível para trabalhar! No segmento de Agronegócio, conquistamos o 1º lugar no Prêmio “Lugares Incríveis para Trabalhar”, posição que mantemos há seis anos. Esse reconhecimento reflete o alto nível de satisfação de nossas pessoas colaboradoras e nossa excelência em gestão de pessoas, clima organizacional e liderança.

Se você tem paixão por sustentabilidade e quer fazer parte de uma transformação positiva no setor florestal, esta é sua oportunidade!

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Planejamento da expedição: Organizar e programação de envio das mudas, definindo prioridades, rotas e prazos de entrega conforme pedidos e capacidade logística.
  • Controle de qualidade: Verificar se as mudas estão em boas condições fitossanitárias, bem formadas e dentro dos padrões exigidos antes do envio.
  • Gestão de estoque: Acompanhar a disponibilidade de mudas no viveiro e o atendimento em cada processo, garantindo que os pedidos sejam atendidos sem faltas ou excessos.
  • Interface com logística e clientes: Manter comunicação com transportadoras e clientes para alinhar prazos, resolver problemas e acompanhar entregas.
  • Controle de documentação: Garantir que toda a documentação necessária (notas fiscais, certificados fitossanitários, etc.) esteja correta e acompanhando a carga.
  • Monitoramento de indicadores: Acompanhar métricas como prazos de entrega, perdas, devoluções e qualidade das mudas expedidas.
  • Melhoria contínua: Identificar falhas no processo e propor melhorias para aumentar eficiência, reduzir custos e manter a qualidade.
  • Garantir a conformidade com normas ambientais e de segurança, especialmente no uso racional de recursos naturais.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Florestal, Agronomia e áreas correlatas;
  • Habilidade em liderança de equipes;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Conhecimento na área de viveiro, voltada para logística, qualidade de mudas e atendimento ao cliente;

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. PassBeyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We’re looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from India and South Asia.

The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals - and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

• Introduce PassBeyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network

• Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks - so they can make an informed decision

• Walk alongside clients from first conversation through to permit in hand

• Build trust through genuine conversation - not scripts or pressure tactics

• Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We’re not looking for cold-callers or lead-chasers. We’re looking for trusted connectors.

Who Our Clients Are

• Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest

• Self-made successes who built wealth through talent and persistence

• Often from environments where institutions have failed them - they’re sceptical for good reason

• Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families

• They value relationships over transactions and won’t be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their scepticism, and guides with patience and honesty.

What We’re Looking For

Essential:

• Existing relationships with HNWIs in LATAM

• Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you’d serve

• Fluent English (written and verbal)

• Comfortable with commission-only compensation

• Integrity - you’d rather lose a deal than mislead someone

Highly Desirable:

• Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

• Active LinkedIn presence

Backgrounds that often do well:

• Business owners and entrepreneurs

• Private bankers and wealth managers

• Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients

• Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets

• Community leaders and well-connected professionals

• Successful diaspora professionals in UK, UAE, Singapore, or Europe

What You Get

• Full training and certification on our programmes - no cost to you

• Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens)

• Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory - not generic sales scripts

• CRM system for pipeline management

• Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients

• Direct support from our Athens headquarters - legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you

Our Values

Freedom - The right to become who you are capable of becoming - unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth.

Integrity - Not a character trait - an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.

Partnership - We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

Nox Soluções Empresariais é uma empresa dedicada a oferecer soluções inovadoras para empresas de diversos setores. Nosso compromisso está em garantir excelência no atendimento e aprimorar a experiência de nossos clientes com serviços de alta qualidade. Contamos com uma equipe qualificada e apaixonada pelo que faz, sempre priorizando a satisfação e as demandas de nossos clientes. Buscamos profissionais que compartilhem de nosso espírito colaborativo e foco em resultados.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Analista de Atendimento para atuar em nossa equipe em um modelo de trabalho híbrido, localizado em Barueri, SP, com possibilidade de trabalho remoto em determinados dias. As principais responsabilidades incluem prestar atendimento ao cliente de maneira eficiente e qualificada, identificar e resolver problemas e garantir altos níveis de satisfação do cliente. Este é um cargo de tempo integral que exige proatividade e habilidade para lidar com desafios no dia a dia.

Qualificações

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Experiência comprovada em suporte ao cliente, garantindo acompanhamento de solicitações e resolução eficiente de problemas.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar situações e dados, identificar problemas e apresentar soluções práticas.
  • Comunicação: É essencial possuir habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com foco em clareza e empatia durante as interações com os clientes e a equipe.
  • Foco na Satisfação do Cliente: Comprometimento em garantir uma experiência positiva e atendimento de excelência aos clientes.
  • Diferenciais incluem familiaridade com sistemas CRM, conhecimentos em gestão de processos e domínio em outras línguas.

title: Analista de Incorporação Pleno
description:
Muito mais do que uma incorporadora e construtora – realizamos sonhos e transformamos vidas!

Somos movidos por resultados e vivemos um momento de crescimento acelerado, com grandes lançamentos previstos e metas ainda mais ambiciosas para os próximos anos.

Se você busca desafios e quer liderar a transformação em uma empresa inovadora e em expansão, essa oportunidade é para você !

O que você fará por aqui:

  • Acompanhar os prazos de desenvolvimento e lançamento de empreendimentos, elaborando e controlando os cronogramas do produto desde a concepção até o lançamento;
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de novos produtos com base em pesquisas de mercado, análise da concorrência, informações comerciais e estudos de viabilidade, em parceria com áreas internas e fornecedores externos;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar a obtenção de documentações e aprovações necessárias junto a órgãos federais, estaduais e municipais para viabilização dos empreendimentos;
  • Monitorar o desenvolvimento dos projetos, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos pela empresa;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Marketing e Inteligência de Mercado na criação de briefings e no acompanhamento das campanhas de lançamento dos empreendimentos;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de materiais de divulgação, ilustrações, maquetes e demais peças utilizadas nas campanhas de lançamento;
  • Participar da implantação e acompanhamento de stands de vendas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e custos;
  • Desenvolver materiais de apoio para treinamento de corretores e argumentação de vendas, considerando os diferenciais competitivos do empreendimento;
  • Apoiar ações promocionais e eventos comerciais, além de contribuir para revisões de campanhas com foco em alavancagem de vendas;
  • Contribuir para estudos de viabilidade econômica dos empreendimentos, acompanhando orçamentos de marketing e incorporação;
  • Elaborar materiais e fornecer informações para o Memorial de Incorporação, acompanhando prazos e etapas do processo;
  • Apoiar processos relacionados à contratação de NBR, estimativa de custos de condomínio junto às administradoras e estudos de permuta de terrenos;
  • Garantir a conservação dos terrenos em estoque, apoiando ações preventivas para evitar riscos ou atrasos nos lançamentos;
  • Preparar a Ficha Resumo do Empreendimento (FRE) e apoiar o departamento de Captação de Recursos na montagem dos processos de pré-análise dos empreendimentos.

O que esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino superior completo em Arquitetura, Engenharia Civil, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em processos de incorporação imobiliária e desenvolvimento de empreendimentos;
  • Vivência no acompanhamento de cronogramas de produto e etapas de lançamento de empreendimentos;
  • Experiência no acompanhamento de aprovações e documentações junto a órgãos públicos;
  • Conhecimento sobre Memorial de Incorporação e documentação necessária para registro de empreendimentos;
  • Experiência na interface com áreas como Projetos, Marketing, Comercial, Jurídico e Inteligência de Mercado;
  • Vivência no acompanhamento de campanhas de lançamento, materiais de vendas e stands de vendas;
  • Excel intermediário ou avançado.

Seria incrível se você tivesse:

  • Experiência prévia em incorporadoras ou construtoras;
  • Experiência com montagem de processos de pré-análise de empreendimentos e elaboração de FRE (Ficha Resumo do Empreendimento);
  • Conhecimento em definição de produto imobiliário e posicionamento de mercado;
  • Experiência no relacionamento com cartórios, administradoras de condomínio e fornecedores do setor imobiliário.

Benefícios que refletem o nosso jeito de cuidar

Na Plano&Plano, acreditamos que cada conquista é construída junto.

Por isso, nossos benefícios foram pensados para apoiar você em todas as fases da jornada, no trabalho, em casa e na vida.

Essenciais para o dia a dia:

  • Vale-refeição no cartão Flash: liberdade total para escolher onde e como usar;
  • Vale-transporte ou fretado: com desconto de até 6%, garantindo mais mobilidade e praticidade;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): porque o sucesso é coletivo e celebramos juntos cada conquista!.

Saúde e bem-estar em primeiro lugar:

  • Assistência Médica Bradesco Saúde: cobertura nacional para cuidar de você;
  • Assistência odontológica Bradesco (opcional): um sorriso saudável também faz parte da nossa rotina;
  • Seguro de Vida MetLife: tranquilidade e proteção para você;
  • Wellhub (Gympass): equilíbrio entre corpo e mente com acesso a academias, terapias e programas de bem-estar;
  • Cartão Natalidade: para celebrar esse momento tão especial com mais tranquilidade.

Qualidade de vida que inspira

  • Emendas de feriados e recesso de fim de ano: tempo extra para descansar e recarregar as energias, sem desconto das férias.

Vantagens que vão além

Outras informações

  • Jornada: segunda a sexta-feira, presencial, porque acreditamos que conexões reais constroem grandes resultados.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.

Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.

We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT?

• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,

• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

• Advanced English (spoken and written),

• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,

• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,

• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,

• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,

• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.

WHAT AWAITS YOU?

• Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

• Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,

• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning,

• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,

• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil,

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• Hybrid working model,

• One day off on your birthday,

• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,

• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,

• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

• Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass,

• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.

In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.

In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Comprador
description:
